page.overview:
Who is Axle and Loco?

Axle and Loco are minor characters in A Bug's Life. They are members of Hopper's gang. Loco is taller and one of Axle's antennas is cut in half.

"Three grasshoppers at the bar don't want to fly back to Ant Island. "When it starts to rain, we might as well be sucking bug spray," one says. They send Molt to talk to Hopper, who squashed the suggestion and the threesome under an avalanche of grain."

They believed that it was pointless to return to Ant Island, as they already had enough food and the rains could come any day, and convinced Molt to give this idea to Hopper as his own, assuming that he would get beaten for such an idea if he didn't like it. When Molt informs Hopper and receives a sharp reply, he tells Hopper that they gave him the idea. Hopper then extracts payback by burying Axle and Loco in a large pile of grain.

During the scene where Flik and the Blueberries are sneaking up the tree to the fake bird, Axle and Loco are seen.
